watch_outs: Foreground flowers are partially obscured by out-of-focus leaves, reducing visibility of individual petals. Background house is indistinct due to bokeh, preventing identification of architectural features.

replies.text: Are those blue stars the whole garden's doing, or is there more hiding in that bed?
Here are two blues!
photos: Description: The image displays the cover of the children’s book “Stacey’s Extraordinary Words” by Stacey Abrams, illustrated by Kitt Thomas, featuring a young Black girl with curly hair and a number 19 badge standing before a microphone under a spotlight. Photograph read: The cover art is rendered in a cartoon style with clear, bold typography and illustrative detail. Lighting is focused on the central figure, with a spotlight effect casting a gradient from yellow to blue. The background shows silhouettes of other figures, some with visible numbers, suggesting a competition or event setting. Photo type: Illustrated book cover

Description: A swing ride at an amusement park, with riders suspended in mid-air against a clear blue sky, surrounded by bare and leafy trees. Photograph read: The image is taken from a low angle, capturing the ride’s central structure and radiating arms. Bright daylight illuminates the scene, with strong contrast between the sky and the ride’s ornate, patterned surfaces. The ride’s details are visible, though some areas are in shadow or partially obscured by the riders’ silhouettes. Photo type: Amusement park ride

replies.text: Two very different blues and both of them land - the book cover pops and the swing ride is pure summer. Which one did you shoot first?

photos: Description: A wooden boardwalk extends from the foreground toward a calm lake under a clear blue sky, flanked by bare trees and dry reeds, with a light dusting of snow on the walkway. Photograph read: The composition leads the eye along the boardwalk, with strong shadows cast by the railing. Bright sunlight illuminates the scene, creating high contrast between the snow, the dark wood, and the blue water. The sky is clear with minimal cloud cover, and the horizon shows a distant treeline. Photo type: Natural landscape

replies.text: That snowy boardwalk leading straight to the lake - the winter light makes the blue feel colder. Was the lake already freezing over?
It was starting to but this was in Tenneessee, USA, so I don’t think the lake ever freezes all the way. But I was just visiting, I don’t know for sure.
Thanks for sharing the walk to the water - it looks like a good place to be.

photos: Description: A bright cyan electric vehicle with black accents and distinctive multi-spoke wheels is parked on a residential driveway, with grass and a sidewalk visible in the foreground and a street and another vehicle in the background. Photograph read: The image is taken in daylight with even illumination, showing clear surface reflections on the car’s paint and distinct edges of the vehicle. The composition is a side profile, with the car occupying most of the frame. The image appears sharp and in focus, with no visible motion blur or chromatic aberration. Photo type: Documentary

replies.text: That cyan is impossible to miss in a plain driveway - the black wheels set it off nicely. What made you pick that color?
Its the wifes car, she had a 22' Leaf in white and when she saw the blue was available she had to trade up!
A trade-up worth making - that blue suits her.

photos: Description: A calm lake under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds, bordered by a dense tree line in the distance; a few rocks are visible in the shallow foreground water. Photograph read: The composition is wide and horizontal, with the water reflecting the sky and clouds. Lighting is bright and even, suggesting midday. The rendering is clear, with natural color saturation and visible surface ripples on the water. Photo type: Landscape

replies.text: Half sky, half water, and the clouds doing the stitching in the middle. Is that a morning lake or an evening one?
Honestly I can’t remember It was our view from a campsite we stayed at for a week.
A week of waking up to that - thanks for sharing the view.

photos: Description: A male peacock stands on green grass, displaying its vibrant blue neck and back, with a partially fanned tail featuring iridescent green and blue feathers; a wire fence is visible in the background. Photograph read: The image is taken in natural daylight with even illumination across the subject; the peacock is in focus, but the background is slightly out of focus; the grass shows some texture and scattered small debris. Photo type: Natural

replies.text: That blue neck against the green is the whole show - the tail just trails behind like an afterthought. Does he fan it out for visitors?
Yes,if he likes the visitors!
A peacock that likes an audience - thanks for sharing him.

photos: Description: The image shows a sky filled with scattered white clouds against a deep blue background, with prominent pink and orange streaks of light illuminating parts of the clouds, suggesting either sunrise or sunset. Photograph read: The composition features a mix of small, fluffy clouds and larger, wispy cloud formations with diffuse, colored edges. Lighting is directional, casting warm tones on the cloud layers while leaving other areas in cooler blue shadow. Rendering appears natural, with no visible signs of digital artifacting or motion blur. Photo type: Atmospheric

replies.text: The pink in those clouds against all that blue - it looks like the sky couldn't decide. What time of day caught it like that?
This was taken pointing straight up at early sunset, where the sun was lighting up the high level clouds with pink rays and the lower popcorn clouds were in the shade as the sun was going down.
Thanks for sharing the sunset - pointing straight up paid off.

photos: Description: The image shows a modern, angular building with a faceted, geometric exterior, set against a dynamic, streaked sky. The building’s surface features a complex pattern of reflective panels and dark recesses. Photograph read: The composition is a low-angle shot emphasizing the building’s upward thrust, with the sky rendered as motion-blurred streaks. Lighting appears to be ambient, with strong contrast between the illuminated facets and deep shadows. The rendering preserves the building’s sharp geometry but lacks fine surface texture detail in some areas. Photo type: Architectural
watch_outs: The sky’s motion blur obscures cloud detail and reduces contrast in the upper portions of the frame. The building’s surface exhibits visible flatness in some areas, where fine geometric patterns are not resolved due to the image’s resolution or depth of field.

replies.text: The building cuts straight up into that sky and the clouds blur past it like it is standing still. What stopped you in front of this one - the building or the sky?

The building for this one. I was just very lucky with the sky at the time I was there to take this. This was a 30s capture of the Titanic Museum in Belfast, Northern Ireland. This building truly looms over the top of you.
Thirty seconds well spent - that building earns its drama.

photos: Description: The photograph shows clusters of small, light blue flowers with yellow centers, growing among green foliage and brown leaf litter on the ground. Photograph read: The image has a shallow depth of field, with the foreground flowers in focus and the background blurred. Lighting appears natural and diffused, casting soft shadows. The rendering is soft, with no visible sharp edges or high-contrast areas. Photo type: Natural

replies.text: Those tiny blue stars with the yellow middles - easy to walk right past and then impossible to unsee. Where did you find the patch?
I can’t remember. It was on a hike a few years ago. I’m always the one at the back, getting behind because I’m always stopping to take photos haha
The back of the hike is where the photos live - thanks for stopping for this one.

photos: Description: The image shows a dark outdoor scene at night, featuring silhouettes of trees and a building with a chimney, overlaid with large, circular bokeh artifacts and faint foreground elements like a branch with berries. Photograph read: The composition is dominated by out-of-focus circular highlights, with indistinct shapes of foliage and architecture visible beneath them. Lighting is low, with some faint illumination from windows or streetlights, and the overall rendering is soft and hazy. Photo type: Unclear
watch_outs: Large bokeh artifacts obscure the entire field of view, making it impossible to discern fine detail in the subject. The foreground branch with berries is partially visible but appears distorted and blurred due to the lens aberrations.

replies.text: The bokeh turns the whole night into bubbles and the house just glows through it. How did you get the circles that big?
Good question. Maybe the rain? 🤷
Rain or not, the bubbles turned out lovely - thanks for sharing the night.
That cloud towers over the whole scene, and then a faint rainbow shows up at the edge. Did you see the rainbow when you shot it, or only later?

photos: Description: The image shows a vast expanse of deep blue water with two small, dark silhouettes near the lower left and a larger, faintly defined structure in the upper right, possibly a lighthouse or buoy. Photograph read: The composition is dominated by a uniform blue field with minimal contrast. The silhouettes and structure are rendered as indistinct shapes with no discernible texture or detail. Lighting appears flat and diffuse, with no visible highlights or shadows. Photo type: Unclear
watch_outs: - The main subject (structure) is indistinct and lacks visible detail, appearing as a blurry, low-contrast form. - The silhouettes in the lower left are too small and lack defining features to be identified.

replies.text: Almost nothing in the frame and it still holds - two tiny figures and a whole ocean of blue. What is that structure out there?
It is a lighthouse, its unfortunate that in this frame the light was out, would’ve been perfect with the ducks 🦆
Even with the light out, the ducks make it - thanks for sharing it.
Lovely flower 💙 A couple of blues...
photos: Description: A vibrant blue flower with ruffled petals is centered in the frame, surrounded by green leaves and small green berries on branches. Photograph read: The flower is in focus with visible texture, but the center is overexposed to a bright white glow. Background foliage is in focus but appears slightly out of focus relative to the flower. Lighting is direct sunlight, creating strong contrast and highlights. Photo type: Natural

Description: A blue and gray bird, likely a Steller’s Jay, perches on a weathered, broken branch against a blurred, dark background of what appears to be forest debris. Photograph read: The bird is in sharp focus, with clear feather texture and coloration, while the background is heavily blurred. Lighting is directional, illuminating the bird’s head and back, with shadows on its underside. The image has a shallow depth of field, with no visible signs of motion blur or sensor noise. Photo type: Portrait
watch_outs: - Center of flower: overexposed to white, obscuring internal structure. - Background foliage: slightly softer focus, reducing detail contrast with the main subject.

replies.text: Two blues, two moods - the flower glows and the jay just stares you down. Which one did you meet first?
The flower 😊

photos: Description: A painted figurine of a soldier in blue uniform with red accents, holding a small dog, stands on a grassy base beside a tree stump, with discarded gear nearby. Photograph read: The image is taken against a dark, uniform background. Lighting is frontal and somewhat flat, casting soft shadows. The figurine and base are in focus, but the image exhibits visible grain and color saturation artifacts, particularly in the dark areas. Photo type: Photographic print
watch_outs: - Visible grain throughout the image, especially in the dark background and base. - Color saturation artifacts in the background and on the figurine’s uniform.

replies.text: The blue uniform against that dark ground is doing all the work - and the little dog steals it anyway. Is he part of the set or a last-minute addition?

The figure is 54mm tall and resin. I think I bought it in Brussels. I added a few details and the ‘groundwork. The dog is part of the casting and probably why I bought the figure! I painted it and the groundwork in artists’ oils. There is no metallic paint used. The brass is all ochres and white. I used a macro ‘filter’ to photograph it. Thanks for the interest!
Fifty-four millimeters of pure patience - the dog makes the whole scene.

photos: Description: A low-angle view of a large white Ferris wheel with dark-tinted passenger cabins against a bright blue sky with scattered white clouds. Photograph read: The image is taken from below, capturing the curved structure and cabins of the Ferris wheel. Lighting is bright and even, suggesting daylight. The rendering is clear, with visible structural details and cabin reflections. Photo type: Documentary

replies.text: Those cabins stacked against all that blue - the wheel fills the whole sky. Did you ride it after?
Yes! That’s the Ferris wheel at the National Harbor outside Washington DC
A wheel that fills the sky - thanks for sharing the ride.

photos: Description: Two individuals stand on a railing overlooking a body of water, extending their arms upward toward a seagull in flight; a small object is visible mid-air between them and the bird. Photograph read: The scene is captured under clear, bright daylight with a wide sky and calm water; the subjects and bird are in focus, though the image lacks visible depth-of-field blur or motion blur. The railing and water show natural texture, and the horizon is distinct. Photo type: Natural

replies.text: I think the timing is the whole shot - one piece of bread in the air and the gull doing the catching. Did it get the next piece too?
We had a whole bunch of them coming through.. probably went through 7 loaves of bread 😂 and there are tons of carp waiting in the water for some too!
Seven loaves and a whole crowd of gulls - thanks for sharing the feast.
Blue flowers
photos: Description: A cluster of light blue, five-petaled flowers with a central green stem, set against a blurred green background of foliage. Photograph read: The main subject is in focus, with soft background blur. Lighting is even and diffused, without harsh shadows or highlights. The image has a shallow depth of field, rendering the background indistinct. Photo type: Macro

replies.text: That cluster is so pale it almost isn't blue until the green sets it off. How long has that bush been blooming?
Street art at the LX Factory in Lisbon.
photos: Description: A tiled mural depicting a pair of large, detailed eyes with a compass rose above them, set against a blue-toned maritime scene with boats and a distant cityscape, viewed through a window with a visible "1.01" label and partial text "mohi". Photograph read: The image is taken from a slightly low angle, with even indoor lighting illuminating the mural. The composition is dominated by the mural, which is rendered on individual tiles with visible grout lines. Reflections are visible on the window glass above the mural. Photo type: Still life
watch_outs: The window glass above the mural reflects people and interior elements, obscuring the top portion of the mural and reducing clarity of the text "mohi" and the "1.01" label. The grout lines between tiles are visible, indicating the mural is composed of discrete, separate tiles.

replies.text: Those eyes in blue tile watch the whole room - the compass rose is the quiet detail. Is the mural old, or a new piece made to look it?

photos: Description: A bright blue convertible pickup truck with white wave-like graphics is parked on grass, viewed from the rear three-quarter angle, with trees in the background. Photograph read: The image is taken in daylight with natural outdoor lighting; the truck is in focus, but the photograph exhibits a slightly faded color tone and mild grain. The background trees are in sharp focus, and the grass shows natural texture. Photo type: Photographic print or digital scan of an older photograph.

replies.text: A convertible pickup in that blue with flame decals - it looks like it drove straight out of a different decade. Does it still run?

Bought it in 1989. Built it in 1991. Drove it for another 20 years. Sold it in 13. It’s for sale in Tennessee it was in Georgia for a while. I’m in Michigan. Ole girl has got around. Has a new motor, sounds strong as ever. Sure was a lot of fun
Twenty years of stories in one truck - thanks for sharing her history.

photos: Description: The image shows a car's side-view mirror reflecting a blue truck with a skull-and-crossbones emblem on its grille and graffiti-style lettering above it. In the background, other vehicles are visible on a highway with grassy embankments and guardrails. Photograph read: The composition is framed by the mirror, with the truck’s front prominently reflected. Lighting is diffuse, suggesting an overcast day. The rendering is somewhat soft, with no visible sharpness or motion blur artifacts. Reflections in the mirror are clear enough to discern details, but the outer edges of the mirror frame are slightly out of focus. Photo type: Reflective

replies.text: The skull on the grille staring back out of your mirror - the truck does the posing and the mirror does the framing. Did you catch it by luck, or were you waiting for it?
he was behind me for a while and took the photo when we stop in the highway.
A highway stop well timed - thanks for sharing the mirror shot.

photos: Description: A distant snow-capped mountain rises above a tree-lined shoreline across a large body of water, with a few small boats visible on the water’s surface. Photograph read: The image has a hazy, atmospheric quality with a clear horizon line separating the water from the land. The mountain is centrally positioned and appears slightly softened. The sky is a uniform pale blue with no visible clouds or texture. The water surface shows gentle ripples and lacks sharp detail. Photo type: Aerial landscape
watch_outs: The mountain’s peak and upper slopes are indistinct due to atmospheric haze, reducing visible texture and contour. The shoreline and distant structures are blurred and lack fine detail, making specific features unreadable.

replies.text: The mountain just floats above the water like it isn't attached to anything. Was the air that clear all day, or did it open up for a minute?
It was clear most of the day, Seattle so it can change often, kind of deceiving , Mt Rainier is 60 miles from Seattle, it is just so large it dwarfs over everything
Sixty miles away and still owning the skyline - thanks for sharing it.

photos: Description: The photograph shows several blue, butterfly-like flowers with prominent purple stamens, set against a backdrop of green leaves and a blurred tree trunk. Photograph read: The image has a shallow depth of field, with the foreground flowers in focus and the background softly blurred. Lighting is even and diffused, illuminating the petals without harsh shadows. The rendering preserves color saturation and texture of the flowers and leaves. Photo type: Natural

replies.text: Clerodendron
They really do look like little blue butterflies mid-flight - the shape is the whole trick. What are they called?
Sunset Lake, Bridgeton, NJ
photos: Description: A large, leafless tree with gnarled branches dominates the foreground, framing a calm body of water under a clear blue sky; distant treelines show autumnal colors. Photograph read: The composition is framed by the tree’s silhouette against the sky, with the water and treeline visible in the midground. Lighting is bright and even, suggesting midday sun. Rendering is sharp in the foreground branches and background treeline, with no visible signs of motion blur, focus issues, or color banding. Photo type: Natural landscape

replies.text: That branch snakes across the whole sky and the lake just sits quiet underneath. Is that a regular walking spot for you?
Sign in an Iceland Air plane.
photos: Description: The photograph shows a close-up of a blue aircraft exterior with white text describing the glacier Vatnajökull, including its geographical and geological features. A small portion of an aircraft window is visible on the right. Photograph read: The image is taken under direct lighting, with visible water droplets on the surface. The text is legible, though slightly distorted by condensation. The surface has a glossy finish, reflecting light and showing minor surface imperfections. Photo type: Documentary

replies.text: A whole glacier's story on a bright blue panel - the sign does the traveling for you. Did you get to see the glacier itself?
Unfortunately not, we were just switching flights in Rejkjavik.
A layover that delivered a glacier - thanks for sharing the sign.
Blue is a great colour!
photos: Description: A calm body of water reflects a gradient sky transitioning from deep blue to pale pink near the horizon, with a dark tree line silhouetted along the far shore. Photograph read: The composition is horizontally oriented, with the water occupying the lower half and the sky the upper. Lighting is soft and diffuse, suggesting twilight. Reflections are clear but muted, and a single small buoy is visible near the center of the water. Photo type: Landscape

replies.text: One little buoy holding the middle of all that blue - the water looks like glass. How long did it stay that still?

photos: Description: A person wearing a blue, fuzzy, hooded onesie with large white eyes and a black mouth on the hood is taking a mirror selfie, holding a smartphone to cover their face. The setting appears to be an indoor room with a ceiling light fixture and two closed doors visible in the mirror’s reflection. Photograph read: The image is captured from a mirror’s perspective, showing a direct frontal view of the subject. Lighting is warm and ambient, primarily from a ceiling fixture above. The image has a moderate level of detail, with visible texture on the onesie fabric and clear outlines of the phone and door frames. Photo type: Portrait
watch_outs: The subject’s face is obscured by the phone, preventing facial identification or expression visibility. The hood’s facial features are partially visible but not fully discernible due to the phone’s position.

replies.text: A Cookie Monster onesie is the most committed blue of the whole day - the mirror selfie just makes it better. What is the occasion for the onesie?
Just the cold weather, I do love both my onesie and Cookie Monster 😊
Cold weather, warm onesie, Cookie Monster - a perfect combination.

photos: Description: A wide expanse of calm water under a heavily clouded sky, with a single small rock visible in the mid-distance and distant tree-lined shores on both sides. The clouds are dense and textured, with some blue sky visible at the horizon line. Photo type: Landscape

replies.text: A whole sea of grey-blue under a rippled sky - the horizon barely holds the two apart. Was it as quiet out there as it looks?
Yes, just me, my husband and the dog.

replies.text: Just the three of you and a whole grey-blue sea - thanks for sharing the walk.

replies.text: Two kinds of blue water in one post - the surf crashing the rocks and then the bay going glass-calm. Which coast is this?
First one is the Isle of Harris in the Outer Hebrides and the second is the tiny port on the island of Eriskay, also on the Outer Hebrides.
Two Hebridean blues in one post - thanks for taking us there.
Blue mist flower

it’s my quartz’s collection
A whole set worth the eighty-mile trip - thanks for sharing it.
The last photo, it was a project, that’s infrared chrome taken at night. It was destination, 80 miles away.

Sunrise on the “Sea of Cortez”—Cabo San Lucas 🇲🇽

Two blues, two worlds, one post - thanks for sharing both.

The view from the end

replies.text: Yes. It’s near Waikiki beach. If you look closely you can see the crabs. It is quite long. This was over half way out.

replies.text: One figure on the edge of all that blue - the sky is the whole backdrop and he just stands in it. How did you find this lookout?
Lookout Mountain, Chattanooga , TN. 😎
One figure on the edge of all that blue - thanks for sharing the view.

photos: Description: A harbor at twilight with moored boats and distant illuminated buildings under a dark, cloud-filled sky; the water reflects the lights and clouds. Photograph read: The image is taken at night with low ambient light, showing a wide view of the harbor and skyline. The sky is dark blue with visible cloud structure. watch_outs: - The entire image is underexposed, obscuring fine detail in the water, boats, and distant structures. - The foreground railing is dark and lacks discernible texture or form due to low light.

replies.text: Nearly black and still all blue - the sky holds the whole frame while the harbor lights just sparkle underneath. What time was this, just after the light went?
This is Camden Harbor, ME, 10/1/2026 at 18:46 Eastern. We waited until the sun just disappeared over the buildings in the background …
Waiting for the sun to drop paid off - thanks for sharing the harbor.
Okay…we were drinking at a bar across the harbor…

replies.text: Five postcards and not a dull one. The cruise ship against the Opera House is the showstopper, but that red rock against the blue sky runs it close. Which of the five was the day's favorite?

photos: Description: The image shows a large, reddish-brown rock formation with vertical striations, set against a clear blue sky, with a foreground of golden grass and scattered shrubs. The image exhibits saturated color tones and visible digital sharpening or enhancement, particularly in the grass and rock textures. Photo type: Digital landscape

replies.text: Uluru in that light is hard to beat - the red against the blue does it. Thanks for sharing it.
When I saw the cruise ship looked at angles thought it would work glad you liked it but the red rocks of uluru are something else with the right light think that photo was one of the olgas

photos: Description: A brightly colored tour boat is moored at a dock beside a calm river, with a concrete bridge spanning the water in the mid-ground and dense green trees behind it under a clear blue sky. Photograph read: The image is composed with the boat on the right, the bridge centered horizontally, and the trees filling the upper background. Lighting is bright and even, suggesting midday sun. Reflections of the boat and bridge are visible on the water’s surface. The image appears to be a standard digital photograph with no visible signs of distortion or compression artifacts. Photo type: Landscape

replies.text: The little blue-and-yellow boat is the whole punchline - the river does the calm and it does the color. What was the boat up to when you caught it?

In Fort Wayne, Indiana, my hometown. It's the 'Sweet Breeze', an authentic replica of an 1840s canalboat. A wheelchair-accessible river cruises featuring stories about local history, river lore, and the city's three rivers (St. Marys, St. Joseph, and Maumee). I was born and raised there, took the river tour before moving to Michigan in 2022, and learned a lot of things I didn't know in my 70 years!!!
Thanks for sharing the ride with us - a hometown river with that much history in it is a gift.

photos: Description: The photograph shows the rear three-quarter view of a blue vintage pickup truck, with a visible exhaust pipe and a chain attached to the tailgate. The truck is parked indoors, with another vehicle partially visible in the background. Photograph read: The image is rendered in a cool, blue-toned color cast with moderate contrast. Lighting appears diffuse, likely from an indoor source, casting soft shadows. The focus is generally sharp on the truck’s body, but the background is slightly out of focus. Photo type: Documentary

replies.text: That blue paint is doing all the talking, and the worn edge by the tailgate tells the rest. How long has that truck been earning its keep?
No idea. I took this through a window. It, and few other old vehicles, were locked inside a silo.
A blue truck locked in a silo, seen through glass - thanks for sharing the find.
You’re welcome! Thanks for commenting on it.
Phoenix Botanical Gardens
photos: Description: A bright blue abstract metal sculpture stands on a circular concrete base in a desert garden, surrounded by cacti, agave plants, and trees under clear daylight. replies.text: That blue ribbon of a sculpture, parked in a cactus garden - it steals the whole path. What stopped you in front of this one?
Hadn’t seen this sculpture before. It’s a new addition to my favorite Phx Botanical Gardens
A new reason to walk a favorite garden - that blue ribbon earns its spot. Thanks for sharing it with us.
My pleasure

Blue lobelia, still in bloom November 12, in Saint Paul. Until tonight. We will finally have a much delayed hard frost tonight.

I store all the hanging baskets and outdoor planters on the balcony and next spring I will amend the soil and plant new flowers. I have a double balcony!

Yes…this was the U2 concert at the Sphere in Las Vegas. As the song continued more insects appeared until it was completely covered. The visual effects for this concert were amazing. I went twice to see the show.
Two visits says it all - thanks for bringing the Sphere to the thread.
Shot with a D7500 IR camera. I need to work on how to process it yet.
photos: Description: The image depicts a vast, forested landscape under a deep purple sky, with distant mountains and a foreground element resembling a pipe or conduit. The composition is wide, showing a foreground object, midground trees, and background mountains. Lighting appears uniform across the scene, with no discernible directional light source. watch_outs: - The foreground object (pipe-like structure) is partially obscured by texture and lacks clear definition due to uniform tonal rendering. - Distant mountain peaks are indistinct and lack visible detail, appearing as smooth, low-contrast silhouettes against the sky.

replies.text: Interesting. How is that different to a normal D7500? Does it shoots infrared?

I bought the camera by mistake. I wanted to upgrade the camera I have. The camera has an infrared sensor built into the camera . I’ve been researching on how to process my photos . Haven’t gotten the kelvin setting right yet . It’s really fun to use though. If anyone has suggestions on how to process photos on Lightroom or photoshop I’m all ears.
A happy accident of a camera - hope the Kelvin settings click soon. Thanks for the story behind it.
The Blues (and white) of Antarctica Nov 25..

The blue attire of this Maasai woman in Tanzania. She is the mother of the current chief. She was so very warm and welcoming. One of my favorite experiences on this trip was meeting this tribe.

replies.text: Half water, half sky, and blue all the way down - hard to tell where the bay ends.
The most delicate blue
photos: Description: A small blue butterfly with white-edged wings rests on a green leaf amidst a patch of grass and weeds. The surrounding vegetation includes broad leaves and some small white flowers. Photograph read: The image is taken from a slightly elevated angle, with natural daylight illuminating the scene. The butterfly is in focus relative to the background, but the overall image has a shallow depth of field, causing some background elements to be out of focus. The rendering is not sharp, with visible softness across the entire frame. Photo type: Natural

replies.text: Gosh, well done capturing that picture, it is beautiful. 💙
Easy to walk right past, and then there it is - the palest blue against all that green. How long did it sit still for you?
Not long. I say it flying first, then took the pic when it settled for a bit
Patience pays off - a settled butterfly and a shot worth the wait. Thanks for sharing it with us.
I got the Blues
photos: Description: A narrow, cobblestone alleyway flanked by buildings painted in various shades of blue, with a prominent arched passageway leading into the distance. A window with iron bars and a hanging flower pot are visible on the left wall, and a hanging lantern is mounted above. Photograph read: The composition is a straight-on perspective down the alley, with the archway creating a leading line. Lighting is diffuse and even, casting soft shadows. The image has a slightly grainy texture and muted color saturation, with no visible signs of motion blur or focus issues. Photo type: Architectural

replies.text: How blue can one alley get? Every wall, the arch, the door at the end - even the shadows lean blue. Did the color pull you down that alley?
It was Chefchaoun Morocco The Blue Pearl There is so much blue!
The Blue Pearl lives up to the name - thanks for taking us there.

photos: Description: The photograph captures the Burj Khalifa at night, illuminated with blue vertical light patterns, viewed from a low angle against a dark sky, with adjacent buildings and ornate street lamps in the foreground. Photograph read: The composition is framed by a warmly lit building on the left and a decorative lamppost on the right, with the Burj Khalifa dominating the center. Lighting is artificial, with the skyscraper’s blue illumination contrasting against the dark sky and the yellow ambient glow of surrounding structures. The image appears to be a standard digital capture with no visible signs of motion blur, lens distortion, or chromatic aberration. Photo type: Urban nightscape

replies.text: The warm gold frame makes the blue tower hit even harder - that contrast is the whole trick. Do you know if the blue was a one-night show?
It is a daily multi color show on Burj Khalifa
photos: Description: The photograph captures the Burj Khalifa at night, illuminated by green laser beams radiating from its base, with surrounding buildings and a crowd of spectators visible in the foreground. Photograph read: The image is taken from a low angle, emphasizing the tower’s height. Lighting is dominated by the green lasers and building lights, with some areas of the tower and surrounding structures appearing bright against the dark sky. The foreground shows silhouettes of people and architectural details of adjacent buildings, but no specific features are sharply defined. Photo type: Night scene

Description: The photograph captures the Burj Khalifa at night, illuminated with red and pink light patterns, viewed from a low angle beside a lit building with ornate architecture and a streetlamp. Photograph read: The image is taken from a street-level perspective, with the Burj Khalifa dominating the center. Lighting is artificial, with warm tones from street fixtures and the building’s facade contrasting with the cool, vibrant illumination of the tower. The rendering shows some visible grain or noise, and the edges of the tower’s structure are not sharply defined. Photo type: Urban nightscape

Description: A nighttime urban scene featuring a tall skyscraper illuminated with blue and purple light projections, with a person’s hands holding a phone at the bottom center. Other lit buildings and a body of water are visible in the foreground and midground. Photograph read: The image is taken from a low angle, with overhead string lights casting warm glow and creating lens flare. The main subject, the skyscraper, is brightly lit with dynamic projections, while surrounding buildings and the water show moderate illumination. The foreground hands and phone are in focus, but the background is not sharply defined. Photo type: Night photography

Description: The photograph captures the Burj Khalifa at night, illuminated with blue laser beams radiating outward from its base, with surrounding buildings and streetlights visible in the foreground and midground. Photograph read: The image is taken from a low angle, emphasizing the height of the tower. The Burj Khalifa is lit with blue laser beams that create sharp, angular lines against the dark sky. Adjacent buildings are lit with warm yellow and white lights, contrasting with the blue beams. The foreground includes architectural structures with decorative lighting. The image appears to be a standard digital capture with no visible signs of distortion or aberration. Photo type: Night cityscape
watch_outs: - The Burj Khalifa’s facade shows visible vertical streaks and uneven illumination, suggesting motion blur or low-resolution capture. - The foreground building’s signage, including “ICARUS,” is partially obscured by glare and angle, reducing legibility.

The foreground hands and phone are in focus, but the background buildings and water show motion blur and low contrast, reducing detail. The main subject’s projected light patterns are partially obscured by the camera’s lens flare and ambient light.

replies.text: A daily show like that is worth the wait every night - thanks for sharing it.

photos: Description: An indoor stage setup with musical instruments, including a drum kit, keyboards, amplifiers, and microphones, under blue stage lighting. A backdrop displays the text “THE CREAKING DOOR” with a cartoon skull graphic. Photograph read: The scene is illuminated by blue stage lights, with multiple spotlights and overhead speakers visible. The stage floor and equipment are covered in cables and gear. The backdrop is partially obscured by shadows and haze. The image is captured from a slightly elevated angle, looking toward the stage. Photo type: Event documentation
watch_outs: - The backdrop text “THE CREAKING DOOR” is partially obscured by haze and lighting, reducing legibility. - The drum kit and amplifiers are in low-contrast areas, with details such as logos and hardware indistinct due to lighting and shadows.

replies.text: What plays here on a normal night? An empty stage, all dressed in blue, the drums ready and nobody home yet.

photos: Description: An indoor concert scene with a band performing on stage under green and red lighting, viewed from the audience; a person in the foreground wears a shirt with “THE BREAKING DOOR” printed on the back. Photograph read: The image is illuminated by stage lights casting green and red hues across the scene; the foreground shows a person’s back and a hand holding a smartphone, while the stage features musicians and equipment, including a drum kit and a circular logo. The image has a shallow depth of field, with the audience members in focus relative to the stage, but some motion blur is visible on the performers. Photo type: Live event photography

Description: An indoor live music venue shows a band performing on a stage with audience members in the foreground, some holding beer bottles. A large banner with partial text is visible to the right, and stage lighting fixtures are mounted overhead. Photograph read: The image is illuminated by stage lights casting purple and blue hues, with visible lighting rigs and cables overhead. The foreground is slightly out of focus, and motion blur is present in the audience members’ limbs. The stage area is brighter, but details are indistinct due to haze and lighting. Photo type: Live event photography
watch_outs: - Motion blur is visible on the performer’s raised arm and torso, indicating movement during capture. - The smartphone screen in the lower-left corner is partially illuminated but not clearly legible due to glare and low contrast.

- Motion blur affects the audience members’ limbs and upper bodies, reducing clarity of movement and facial features. - Haze or smoke in the air diffuses light and obscures fine detail across the stage and audience area.

replies.text: A normal night there looks anything but normal - thanks for the front-row view.
Blue over blue
photos: Description: A bright blue sky with scattered white clouds forms the background, viewed above a row of vertical, uniformly painted blue wooden panels that occupy the lower third of the frame. Photograph read: The composition is framed with the sky dominating the upper portion and the blue panels in the foreground. Lighting is even and natural, suggesting daylight. Rendering is clear and sharp across the visible elements, with no visible signs of motion blur, chromatic aberration, or sensor noise. Photo type: Still life

replies.text: Blue over blue is right - the fence planks and the clouds are playing the same game. Did you paint that fence, or find it that way?
Found it that way.
Found it that way and left it perfect - thanks for sharing it.

photos: Description: The photograph shows a modern multi-story building with a grid of reflective blue-tinted windows set into a dark, textured facade, viewed from a low angle against a uniformly bright, overcast sky. Photograph read: The image is taken from a low angle, emphasizing the building’s verticality. Lighting is diffuse and even, with no strong shadows or highlights. The windows reflect a pale sky, and some show faint interior or external reflections. The image has a slightly soft focus, with no visible sharpness or distortion. Photo type: Architectural

replies.text: A whole grid of blue windows, each one catching a different bit of sky. Which floor would you pick for the view?
The last one. I would have a perfect view over a part of Vienna.
A view over Vienna is a fine reward - thanks for sharing it.
My son in law teaching his son how to bait a hook ❤️
photos: Description: Three men are on a wooden pier overlooking water under a clear sky; one man in the foreground is adjusting a fishing line or lure, while another stands nearby observing, and a third is further back facing away. Photograph read: The image is taken in bright daylight with strong contrast between the subjects and the sky. The pier’s wood grain and the water’s surface are visible, but the image lacks sharpness in the foreground subject’s hands and fingers. The background is relatively clear, with no visible motion blur or lens distortion. Photo type: Outdoor snapshot
watch_outs: The foreground subject’s hands and fingers are indistinct due to soft focus, making fine details of the fishing equipment unreadable. The man in the blue shirt’s facial features are partially obscured by shadow and slight blurriness, reducing facial clarity.

photos: Description: A wide river reflects a vibrant blue sky with scattered cumulus clouds and a distant urban skyline, bordered by dense green foliage. Photograph read: The composition is horizontally balanced, with the water surface mirroring the sky and distant buildings. Lighting is bright and even, suggesting midday. Rendering is sharp across the entire frame, with clear reflections and defined edges on clouds, trees, and structures. Photo type: Landscape

replies.text: Magnificent!
Many thanks 😊
How still was that water? The sky gets a full second showing and the reflection holds every cloud - I kept flipping between the two halves to tell which was real.
Many thanks 😊 that’s a river whose estuary needs to be dredged till then we get great reflections when the wind Gods don’t disturb it😅 the estuary is a few kms down stream…
A river that saves its mirror for the calm days - worth the wait. Thanks for sharing it.
Many thanks 😊
Many thanks 😊

photos: Description: A vertical blue sign for "Estate & Letting Agents" with the logo "fbm" is mounted on a light blue building facade, alongside a Swedish flag and a street sign reading "SERGEANT'S LANE." Two white-framed windows are visible on the building’s upper floors. Photograph read: The image is taken from a slightly low angle, with even, diffused lighting suggesting an overcast day. The sign and building walls are in focus, with no visible motion blur or lens distortion. The rendering is clear, with no apparent color or contrast issues. Photo type: Documentary

replies.text: The yellow stripe in that flag is doing the heavy lifting - everything else is blue on blue, and then it pops. What made you stop for this one?
I noticed just that colour combination. It was in a very colourful town - to wit, Tenby, in Wales - so I was prepared for photo opportunities.
Tenby wears those colors well - a town that hands you the shot. Thanks for sharing it with us.
Blue-eyed grass
photos: Description: A single small blue flower with five petals and a yellow center is in focus, set against a blurred green and yellow background. Photograph read: The flower is centrally framed with shallow depth of field, creating a soft background. Lighting is even and diffused, highlighting the petal texture and center. The image appears to be a close-up macro shot with no visible signs of motion blur or sensor noise. Photo type: Macro

replies.text: A tiny blue star with a yellow middle - the small flowers show up best close in.

photos: Description: A vibrant purple flower with a pinkish center and green reproductive parts is centered in the frame, surrounded by green leaves with visible veins and minor damage. Photograph read: The flower is in sharp focus with saturated color rendering, set against a background of green foliage that is slightly out of focus. Lighting appears even and natural, highlighting the flower’s texture and color gradients without harsh shadows or overexposure. Photo type: Macro

Description: A weathered blue barn with a rusted metal roof stands under a clear blue sky, flanked by bare trees and a red fence in the foreground. Photograph read: The barn is centrally framed with strong contrast between its blue siding and the sky. Lighting is bright and even, suggesting midday. The image has a natural color rendition with visible texture on the barn’s surface and roof. Photo type: Documentary

Description: A close-up of a vibrant blue flower with a dark, textured center, set against a softly blurred green and brown background. Photograph read: The image is a macro shot with shallow depth of field, focusing sharply on the flower’s petals and center. Lighting is bright and even, highlighting petal texture and central structures. The background is uniformly out of focus, with no discernible objects or features. Photo type: Macro

Description: A small, vividly blue bird perches atop a slender, weathered tree stump, with a larger, gnarled, mossy branch to its left, set against a softly blurred green background. Photograph read: The bird and stumps are in sharp focus, with natural, even lighting. The background exhibits a smooth bokeh effect, indicating a shallow depth of field. The image is rendered with high color saturation and contrast, preserving fine feather detail and bark texture. Photo type: Portrait
watch_outs: - The center of the flower contains a small dark hole, likely from insect activity, which obscures part of the reproductive structure. - Several leaves in the background show irregular holes and discoloration, reducing visual clarity in those areas.

replies.text: I am soooo jealous 😁 in a nice way because if you have grown this then either me or the weather are crap. Absolutely amazingly beautiful 💙💗
Thank you. It was a weed in our vegetable garden. The light was just right.
Four blues and not one repeats itself - the morning glory steals it for me with that pink center, but the bunting on the snag is a close second. Which of the four did you shoot first?
Thank you 😊 The morning glory was first.
The morning glory earned its spot - thanks for the four blues.
Thank you so much 😊

photos: Description: Two jellyfish with translucent, elongated tentacles and orange-brown domed bells are visible against a solid, deep blue background. Photograph read: The composition is centered on the two jellyfish, with the larger one on the left and a smaller one to its right. Lighting is uniform and illuminates the jellyfish from the front, making their tentacles glow against the blue. The image has a smooth, saturated color tone with no visible grain or noise. Photo type: Aesthetic

replies.text: Two jellyfish drifting through a whole ocean of blue - those amber bells against the deep blue feel like lanterns. How long did you stand there watching them pulse?
I was wondering if I could use your words for my jellyfish please, I will mention your name...
Seemed like forever! Maybe about 2 to 3 minutes... I just love them. Just like elegant ballerina... took the photo at Atlanta Aquarium... Love your words too ❤️
They really do move like ballerinas. Thanks for sharing them.
My pleasure 🙏...

photos: Description: A modern high-rise building with a blue glass facade and white structural accents, framed by palm fronds at the top corners, under a clear sky; a large sign reading "GRAND TOURANE" is visible at the base. Photograph read: The image is taken from a low angle, emphasizing the building’s height. Lighting is bright and even, suggesting midday sun. Reflections on the glass surface are visible, and the building’s geometric lines are sharp and well-defined. Photo type: Architectural

replies.text: Those palm fronds framing the top corners are the perfect touch. The glass does the blue, the fronds do the holiday, and the gold letters finish it. Is that tower as tall in person as it looks here?

photos: Description: A woman in a blue jacket walks on a sidewalk, carrying a plastic bag and a woven tote, with a cyclist visible in the background under trees and a “KOKOMO IND K USA” banner. Photograph read: The image is taken in bright daylight with strong contrast between sunlit areas and deep shadows. The foreground sidewalk and the woman are in focus, while the background is partially obscured by foliage and a distant figure. The banner is clearly legible, and the composition follows a linear path along the sidewalk. Photo type: Street photography

replies.text: Head-to-toe blue, bags in both hands, striding straight down the middle of the sidewalk - she has somewhere to be and the whole street knows it. Did she notice you, or was this a grab-and-go?
A quick shot from the backseat!
From the backseat, no less - thanks for sharing it.

photos: Description: A person viewed from behind stands between two dense clusters of blue and white balloons, with a metal cart structure visible beneath them and a bright sky in the background. Photograph read: The image is taken from a low angle, with the balloons framing the subject. Lighting is bright and even, suggesting daylight. The balloons are in sharp focus, while the person and background are less detailed. The composition is symmetrical around the central figure. Photo type: Event photography

replies.text: Framed by balloons on all sides and still the guy in the middle owns the shot - that tunnel of blue and white is pure parade energy. Was this the float setting off, or coming home?
A parade around town of candidates for a local Mr. & Ms. Tourism Ambassador before the competition event.
A parade like that is a gift for the camera - thanks for sharing it.
Happy to share! ▓

nodes.text: Red Wednesday favorites 🏆 6 reds that stopped my scroll: @posts.by.norman - red festival gown Lyndall Ley @elanel50 - Remembrance Day poppies @bojonvelvet2.0 - giant red lips Rick King @artiekay2 - balloon from below @refracted_reveries - backlit red leaves Remon Diaz @remondiazart - man with red balloon Beautiful work, all of you. Reel: https://www.instagram.com/reel/DfokW4yD3QG/
photos: Description: A woman in a voluminous red traditional costume with ornate headpiece and feathered accessories is the central figure in a street parade, surrounded by other performers in yellow and white attire. Photograph read: The image is taken from a slightly elevated angle, capturing the parade on a paved street with buildings and spectators in the background. Lighting is bright daylight, casting clear shadows and highlighting the textures of the costumes. The main subject is in sharp focus, while the background shows some motion blur and depth of field blur. Photo type: Cultural event documentation

Description: A pair of hands places red poppies onto a dark memorial plaque engraved with names, with additional poppies already affixed nearby. Photograph read: The image is composed with the hands and poppies in the foreground, the engraved plaque occupying the background. Lighting is even and diffused, illuminating the plaque’s surface and the poppies’ texture. Rendering is clear enough to read most names, though some are partially obscured by the angle or overlapping elements. Photo type: Documentary

Description: A large, stylized red lips sculpture is displayed on a paved area, with numerous sailboat masts visible in the background under a partly cloudy sky. Photograph read: The image is taken from a frontal perspective with even, diffused lighting. The sculpture is in sharp focus, while the background masts and sky are slightly out of focus. The rendering is flat and graphic, with no visible lens distortion or chromatic aberration. Photo type: Documentary

Description: A hot air balloon viewed from below, displaying a radial pattern of red, yellow, and black panels against a blue sky with scattered clouds. Photograph read: The balloon dominates the frame, with a central basket visible. Lighting appears natural and diffused, casting soft shadows within the balloon’s panels. The sky shows moderate cloud cover, and the image has a standard photographic resolution without visible compression artifacts. Photo type: Aerial

Description: The photograph shows a cluster of red maple leaves in bright sunlight, with the sun positioned behind them, creating a starburst effect against a pale sky. A tree trunk is visible on the left. Photograph read: The composition is a low-angle shot looking up through the leaves, with the sun centered behind them. The leaves are backlit, showing their veins and edges, while the sun’s rays create a prominent starburst pattern. The image has high contrast between the bright sun and the saturated red leaves. Photo type: Nature photography

Description: An older man with white hair, seen from behind, walks away from the camera, holding a red balloon on the right side of the frame; the background is out of focus with indistinct green and gray tones. Photograph read: The image has a shallow depth of field, with the man and balloon in relative focus while the background is blurred. Lighting is even and diffuse, with no harsh shadows or highlights. The red balloon is rendered with solid color and smooth surface texture. Photo type: Portrait
watch_outs: - The engraved text on the plaque is partially obscured by the angle and overlapping poppies, making some names illegible or difficult to read. - The hands and poppies are in sharp focus, but the plaque’s engraved text is not uniformly legible due to perspective and partial occlusion.
The background is heavily blurred, obscuring any identifiable environmental features. The man’s face and upper features are not visible due to the back-facing perspective and lack of facial detail.

replies.text: Gorgeous picks....
Thank you!
My pleasure 🙏
@posts.by.norman Your festival dancer opens the Red Wednesday favorites - that red gown takes over the whole street. What is the Sapao-an Festival celebrating, and how close were you to the parade?

Grateful for this, Saar! ▓ The Sapao-an Festival is an annual event held every October in Cardona, Rizal, a small rural town where I used to reside (living in a city area now). The festival includes a street dancing competition participated in by local groups, associations and schools. Each group would have a lead dancer carrying an image of the town's patron saint. I returned for several days to the town to be able to get some photos of the street parade, among other things. ▓
A festival worth going back for. Thanks for the story behind the gown.
My pleasure!
@elanel50 Your Remembrance Day poppies are slide two of the Red Wednesday favorites - hands placing one poppy among the engraved names. Is there a name on that wall you were there for?

I was there at this spot (one of several at the AWM) for Flying Officer Trevor Ley, a navigator killed in a training accident in WWII. He was my father’s cousin. Dad’s uncle was KIA in WWI and his great uncle died in the Boer War in South Africa. My grandfather was wounded in WEI but survived. Lots to remember.
That’s quite a few stories. Thanks for sharing with us!

@bojonvelvet2.0 Your giant red lips are the middle slide of the Red Wednesday favorites. A sculpture that size on a marina promenade is hard to miss - where is it, and does it stop everyone the way it stopped me?

@artiekay2 Your balloon from below is slide four of the Red Wednesday favorites - a perfect target of red and yellow rings. How long did you have to wait for it to drift into the middle of your frame?
Thank you for the pick. I was just sitting there in my work truck waiting for my daily assignments and watching the balloons launch when this one floated over my head.
Right place, right moment. Thanks for sharing it.

@refracted_reveries Your backlit red leaves are slide five of the Red Wednesday favorites. The sunburst lands right in the middle of all that red - did you move around the tree hunting for the gap in the leaves, or did the light find you?

@remondiazart Your man with the red balloon closes the Red Wednesday favorites. The whole frame stays quiet except that one loud circle of red - was he holding it, or did it drift into your shot at the right moment?
Thank you. It was just a scene where there was a small child with a balloon. The zoom did the rest.
Sometimes the zoom is all it takes. Thanks for sharing it.

nodes.text: Red Wednesday ❤️ Show me red. Red is everywhere once you look for it - a door, a flower, a sign, a sunset. Show me the reddest thing on your camera roll. These blooms are red turned all the way up - find me your red. ONE photo. Replying is consent: • Top 5 featured tomorrow on Threads, pinned • Top 3 also in the Instagram reel • Full credit to the author everywhere • Standouts may join a best-of-the-week reel What red stopped you today?
photos: Description: Two bright red flowers with yellow centers stand out against a softly blurred green background, suggesting a garden setting with natural light. Photograph read: A shallow depth of field isolates the vivid blooms, with gentle bokeh and natural lighting enhancing their saturated color and delicate form. Photo type: Artistic

Description: The photograph shows a set of red metal chairs and a matching table under a red-and-white striped awning, against a solid red background. Photograph read: The composition is dominated by saturated red tones, with the chairs and table arranged in the foreground. Lighting is even and direct, casting minimal shadows. The rendering is flat, with no visible depth of field variation or texture detail beyond the chair’s metal mesh and curved frame. Photo type: Still life

Description: A pair of feet wearing red Mary Jane shoes and white lace-trimmed socks stands on a speckled, textured floor, viewed from a high angle. Photograph read: The image is captured from above, with natural lighting casting shadows across the floor. The subject is in focus, but the background floor has a granular texture with no discernible depth of field issues. The rendering is clear and well-lit, with no visible distortion or color aberration. Photo type: Portrait

Description: A close-up photograph shows a vibrant red, ruffled flower with a speckled center and delicate stamens, surrounded by green, textured leaves, positioned near a window frame. Photograph read: The image is a close-up with natural lighting, capturing fine surface textures on the petals and leaves. The focus is centered on the flower’s center, with the background slightly out of focus. No visible signs of motion blur, overexposure, or underexposure. Photo type: Macro

replies.text: That speckled white center is the part I keep coming back to - the ruffled red petals frame it like a little stage. Is this one a windowsill regular, or a new arrival?

photos: Description: An ornate theater interior with tiered red seating, a grand circular ceiling with painted frescoes, and a large red curtain at the stage end, illuminated by chandeliers and spotlights. Photograph read: The composition is wide-angle, capturing the curved seating and ceiling. Lighting is warm and directional, with chandeliers and stage lights casting highlights and shadows. The image has a shallow depth of field, with foreground seats in focus and background elements slightly softer. The red curtain is brightly lit, creating a strong contrast with darker areas of the theater. Photo type: Architectural

replies.text: A whole theater in red - the seats, the curtain, the gold doing the rest. What were you there to see?
That’s the Chicago Theater. I’ve seen several shows there .

photos: Description: A young baseball player in a red jersey with the number 7 is captured mid-stride on a base, while another child in a blue jersey with the number 10 stands nearby. Other players and an adult are visible in the background behind a chain-link fence on a grassy field. Photograph read: The image is taken in bright daylight with strong shadows cast by the subjects. The main subject is in focus, but the background is slightly out of focus. The grass and fence are rendered with natural detail, and the lighting creates contrast between sunlit areas and shaded regions. Photo type: Sports action

Description: A vibrant pink hibiscus flower with five broad petals and a central cluster of yellow stamens is in focus, surrounded by dark green leaves on a bush; the background shows out-of-focus grass and a distant structure. Photograph read: The main subject is sharply rendered, with visible petal texture and stamen detail. The background is softly blurred, indicating a shallow depth of field. Lighting is diffuse, casting even illumination without harsh shadows or highlights. Photo type: Portrait

Description: A single, vividly colored flower with bright red petals and a dense, yellow center is in focus, set against a softly blurred background of green foliage and indistinct vertical elements. Photograph read: The main subject is sharply rendered, with clear petal edges and central florets. The background exhibits shallow depth of field, creating a smooth bokeh effect. Lighting is even and natural, illuminating the flower without harsh shadows or overexposure. Photo type: Macro

replies.text: Red flame ….
photos: Description: The photograph shows a cluster of bright red, tubular flowers with green leaves, viewed from a low angle against a sunlit, out-of-focus background of foliage and a bright light source. Photograph read: The image is characterized by strong backlighting from the sun, creating lens flare and a bright, overexposed area in the upper left. The main subject is partially backlit, with some areas of the flower appearing as silhouettes or underexposed. The background is heavily blurred, and the foreground flower is not sharply focused. Photo type: Natural
watch_outs: - The main subject (red flowers) is partially obscured by backlighting, causing loss of detail and contrast in the petals. - The background is indistinct due to shallow depth of field and bright ambient light, reducing context clarity.

replies.text: That glow through the red tubes is the whole shot - the sun streaking across the frame does the rest. Were you shooting straight into the light for this one?
I was … taking a chance … 🙃 Almost blinded … do you do that ? Just take a chance you can capture magic …▓▓▓▓
Eyes or sensors? 😂😂🤣
Always eyes … so I wouldn’t win any prizes …

photos: Description: A potted plant with vibrant red flowers and green, lobed leaves is positioned in front of a dark metal railing, with parked cars visible in the background through the railing. Photograph read: The image is taken in bright daylight, with strong sunlight illuminating the flowers and casting shadows. The composition is dominated by the plant, with the railing and background slightly out of focus. The rendering shows natural color saturation and visible texture on the petals and leaves. Photo type: Natural

Description: A potted plant with large, vividly colored leaves featuring a pink center and dark purple margins, displayed on a wooden table outdoors, with a garden background containing other flowering plants. Photograph read: The image is composed with the plant as the central focus, captured under bright, even outdoor lighting. The leaves show clear texture and color contrast, with the pot and table in the foreground. Background elements are softly out of focus, indicating a shallow depth of field. Photo type: Portrait

Description: A poinsettia plant with vibrant red bracts and green leaves is photographed from a close, slightly elevated angle, resting in a decorative pot on a light-colored surface. Photograph read: The image is brightly lit by direct sunlight, casting strong highlights and shadows across the bracts and leaves. The composition is tight, focusing on the central cluster of bracts, with some background foliage and the pot’s rim visible. The rendering is clear enough to discern leaf texture and color variation, though some areas are overexposed. Photo type: Natural

replies.text: The geraniums on the porch against the parked cars - red flowers, everyday street behind them, and it still stops you. And then the poinsettia in full sun. Which of the three do you keep coming back to?
Red on blonde ✨️
photos: Description: A woman with blonde hair, wearing a red off-the-shoulder dress, sits on a bed covered with white fabric and takes a mirror selfie, holding a black phone that obscures part of her face. Photograph read: The image is captured from a mirror’s reflection, showing a medium shot of the subject. Lighting is even and diffuse, likely from an indoor source, with no visible shadows or harsh highlights. The rendering is clear enough to discern clothing, posture, and minor details like a tattoo on the lower leg and a framed artwork on the wall. Photo type: Portrait

replies.text: Red on blonde indeed - that dress against the white bedding is the whole shot, and the little red figure in the frame behind you echoes it. Was this a night-out dress or a just-because one?
